project_summary.summary: The Spring Pet Clinic is a comprehensive web application built using the Spring Framework, utilizing Java as the primary programming language. It provides a robust set of features for managing veterinary clinics and their operations, including patient management, appointment scheduling, and billing. The project showcases a well-structured architecture, adhering to the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern, with a focus on separation of concerns and maintainability.

layers: Presentation Layer: Controllers, Views; Business Logic Layer: Services; Data Access Layer: Repositories

development_practices.testing: Unit testing and integration testing are performed using JUnit and TestNG, ensuring comprehensive coverage of the application.
development_practices.logging: Logging is implemented using Logback, providing detailed information about application execution and errors.
development_practices.security: Security measures include authentication and authorization using Spring Security, protecting against common web attacks.
development_practices.documentation: Documentation is maintained using Spring documentation and Javadoc comments, ensuring clarity and maintainability.

code_quality.organization: Code organization is well-structured, with clear separation of concerns between layers and modules.
code_quality.maintainability: The codebase is modular, allowing for easy maintenance and extension of individual components.

infrastructure.deployment: The application is deployed using Tomcat, a popular Java-based web server.
infrastructure.monitoring: Monitoring and observability are achieved through Spring Boot Actuator, providing insights into application performance and health.
infrastructure.scalability: Scalability considerations include the use of Spring Cloud, enabling horizontal scaling and load balancing.
